verdict.rationale: UKVI's GOV.UK pages give plain-language, second-person explainers for founder tasks. The Innovator Founder page states eligibility in plain terms, exact fees by filing location, that you must apply online with separate in-country and out-of-country flows, and settlement timing. Supporting pages cover a visa-finder tool and processing times. missing for 10: an explicitly numbered step-by-step walkthrough of the founder application (sequencing is only implied), independent or hands-on corroboration that non-lawyers can follow it.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers

citations.quote: you want to set up and run an innovative business in the UK - it must be something that’s different from anything else on the market
